messages:
jordan: incident-bot just fired a burst alert: `SIEM: KMS Decrypt Spike` — ~2k events in 5m, >90% from service-account `svc-heartbeat` across us-west-2. looks like noise not a compromise.
sec-bot: alert generated by rule `kms_decrypt_anom_v2` at 1987654310. correlated with CloudTrail `Decrypt` events.
eli: seeing same. dashboard shows very regular 1m cadence from a set of instances. likely health-check traffic.
maya: can we suppress these? it's flooding the paging channel and hiding other sigs.
sam: quick idea: add an allowlist for `principalId` or `userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName` that matches our heartbeat svc. also add a frequency threshold tied to source tags.
riley: +1. we should avoid blanket suppression. prefer enrichment: attach `is_heartbeat=true` if cloud tags include `heartbeat:true` or the event `source` contains our probe lambda.
jordan: agreed. actionables: (1) short-term mute the SIEM alert for 30m while we ship a rule tweak, (2) implement enrichment + suppression rule, (3) update runbook to include heartbeat signature so future false positives are faster to triage.
maya: i'll mute for 30m. done. :mute:
sam: proposed rule snippet (pseudo-sql/sigma):
```
SELECT * FROM cloudtrail_decrypt
WHERE eventName = 'Decrypt'
AND NOT (userIdentity.principalId IN ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/heartbeat/*')
         OR resourceTags.heartbeat = 'true'
)
GROUP BY principalId HAVING count(*) > 50 IN 5m
```
eli: looks good. also add `AND NOT (sourceIPAddress IN (internal_cidr_range))` — those heartbeats come from our VPC NATs.
riley: do we have a dashboard card showing alert volume by principal+region? want to confirm we won't accidentally filter a real spike.
jordan: dashboard exists but it's coarse. can someone add a timeseries by `principalId` + anomaly score? put it on the Sec Ops runbook view.
maya: i'll add a temporary panel. ETA 20m.
sam: after enrichment, add a canary rule: a duplicate rule that still counts suppressed events but doesn't page; that way we can track baseline falsely-suppressed rate for 48h.
eli: good call. also add an audit log entry for the mute and the rule change (compliance needs the trail).
jordan: who's owning the rule PR? sam?
sam: i'll open PR to SIEM rules repo, include unit tests (mock events) and a note about principals to exclude. tagging @maya for dashboard changes and @eli for audit log.
maya: ack.
riley: post-incident tasks: update docs with signature, add an eval that runs weekly to detect new heartbeat principals, and schedule a 1hr retrospective if suppression triggers >5% of past volume.
jordan: thanks team. i'll create a short postmortem-lite in incidents channel after we verify the new rule runs clean for 24h.
sec-bot: note: muted alert `kms_decrypt_anom_v2` by maya at 1987654410 for 30m.
maya: unmute scheduled at 1987656210.
sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/siem-rules/pull/472 — includes enrichment and canary rule.
eli: i'll push the audit log entry now and link in PR.
maya: dashboard panel up: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/siem-runbook?panelId=23 — shows per-principal rates.
jordan: great. check back in 24h and if all good we'll fold suppression into main rule and document in the runbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
